name: v8-empty-skinids-matrix
description: MatrixPCDefense_v4.3 (w3i v25 editorVersion 6059, empty 16-byte v8.11 war3mapUnits.doo): Studio opens terrain view and saves, adding all 9 start locations without skinId (skinIds: false); then the World Editor opens Studio's saved map (from: studio) and saves cleanly without crashing, with all 9 starts and ally masks matching Studio.

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !s.placedObjects()?.units; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.commands.execute('workbench.save'); await w3Workbench.settled(); const doc = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3mapUnits.doo.json')); if (doc.skinIds !== false) throw new Error(`expected skinIds false, got ${doc.skinIds}`); const starts = doc.units.filter((u) => u.id === 'sloc'); if (starts.length !== 9) throw new Error(`expected 9 starts, got ${starts.length}`); if (starts.some((u) => 'skinId' in u)) throw new Error('pre-Reforged unit got skinId');
